title: Chicha Morada
notes: This is a popular non-alcoholic drink in Peru, where it is valued as a refreshing health drink. It can also be fermented to become a lightly alcoholic beverage. The purple corn gives the drink a beautifully, deep purple hue. At Chicha it is infused in cocktails and it is great mixed with Pisco.

ingredientSections.heading: Chicha Morada
items: 1 Ear Dried Purple Corn (available from specialty South American stores)
½ Small Pineapple, roughly chopped with rind on

methodSections.heading: Chicha Morada
steps: Put all the ingredients except the sugar and lime in a pot.
Bring to the boil, then simmer over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat, stir in the sugar and let cool.
Add lime juice. Adjust sweetness with more sugar if desired.
To serve, pour over lots of ice. Add a couple of lime slices to each glass if desired.
